evals.name: analyze-skill-file-with-macro
evals.prompt: 分析一下 /Users/carlyu/soft/projects/agent-powers/refer/superpowers/skills/brainstorming/SKILL.md，我需要彻底理解这个头脑风暴 skill 是如何工作的。请逐段翻译并总结要点。
evals.expected_output: 先输出宏观概览（文档定位、核心主张、结构骨架、关键洞察），然后逐段翻译分析，包含原文、中文翻译、要点，以及引用文件解释
assertions: Output must start with macro overview (分析概要)
Must include document type, core claim, structure skeleton
Must have paragraph-by-paragraph breakdown with Original/Translation/Key Points
Must have final Overall Summary section

evals.name: analyze-workflow-doc-english-user
evals.prompt: 帮我理解这个文档：/Users/carlyu/soft/projects/agent-powers/docs/gsd/01-map-codebase-workflow.md。我英语不太好，请带我一步步看懂。
evals.expected_output: 先给宏观概览，然后段落化分析，每段都有翻译和要点，整体有总结
assertions: Must provide macro overview before paragraph analysis
Every paragraph must have Chinese translation

evals.name: analyze-with-references
evals.prompt: 详细分析一下 brainstorming skill 的 visual-companion.md 文件，包括它引用的所有脚本文件。我要复刻这个功能。
evals.expected_output: 包含宏观概览、visual-companion.md 的逐段分析，以及对 scripts/ 目录下相关脚本的详细解释
assertions: Must analyze referenced script files with code structure and logic explanation
Final summary must include 'How to Replicate/Apply' section

evals.name: verify-macro-first-enforcement
evals.expected_output: 即使文档很短，也必须先输出宏观概览，然后再逐段分析
assertions: Must NOT skip macro overview even for short documents
Must follow Step 0 → Step 1 → Step 3 sequence

evals.name: verify-original-file-only
evals.prompt: 分析一下 /Users/carlyu/soft/projects/agent-powers/refer/superpowers/skills/brainstorming/SKILL.md。注意：docs/superpowers/ 目录下可能已经有一个旧的分析文件，不要读它。
evals.expected_output: 直接读取并分析 brainstorming/SKILL.md 原始文件，不依赖任何已有的分析文件
assertions: Must NOT read any existing analysis files in docs/
Must read ONLY the original file specified by user
